claim_ceiling: On the frozen contamination-screened 113-goal primary set (5 families x 4 CRUD ops, 6 phrasings per cell minus 7 flagged), using the resolved all-MiniLM-L6-v2 checkpoint 1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41, max-cosine embedding selection (A-EMBED-COSINE) does NOT strictly exceed — and in fact falls materially below — a fixed bank-blind deterministic operation-synonym + resource-noun resolver (B-LEX-STRONG). The paired family-blocked 95% bootstrap upper bound is -0.0268 (strictly below zero). Separately, neither the two-feature logistic gate nor the single-feature global-threshold gate meets the preregistered calibration targets (pooled_false_accept <= 0.10, unknown_precision >= 0.85, coverage >= 0.50); both collapse to t*=1.0 with coverage 0.0. This establishes a bounded negative for the embedding-necessity sub-claim and the applicability-gate sub-mechanism on this specific fixture, bank, split, and checkpoint. It does not establish or refute C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE globally, does not transfer to other fixtures/checkpoints, and grants no product promotion.
